extraction.text:
Bal Chandra Jha

Email: balagiftian@gmail.com| M: +91-9590858952

Manager-Data Scientist | ML Engineer | GenAI Engineer

AI/ML leader with 11+ years’ experience delivering measurable business value through end-to-end machine learning systems, MLOps, and Generative AI solutions. Proven track record in designing scalable pipelines, architecting LLM-driven applications, and leading full-lifecycle deployments in enterprise environments. Adept at translating business goals into data-driven solutions that scale and evolve with rapidly changing AI advancements.

Skill

Programming & Scripting: Python | PySpark | SQL | Pandas | NumPy | Scikit-learn

Machine Learning & Deep Learning: Supervised & Unsupervised Learning | Classification | Regression | Clustering | Recommendation Systems | CNN | RNN | Transformers | LLMs (BERT, GPT)

Generative AI & LLMs: OpenAI APIs | Azure OpenAI | LangChain | LangGraph | LangSmith | Huggingface Transformers | RAG | Prompt Engineering | Agents | FAISS | ChromaDB | Vector DBs (Pinecone, Weaviate) | Crew AI

MLOps & Deployment: MLflow | DVC | Docker | Kubernetes | CI/CD Pipelines | FastAPI | Streamlit | Flask | Git 

Cloud & Platforms: Azure Databricks | Unity Catalog | AWS (SageMaker, EC2, S3, Lambda) | Dataiku | GCP

Visualization & Monitoring: Tableau | Power BI | Jupyter | VS Code

Professional Experience

Capgemini — Manager, Data Science   					       			             Mar 2019 – Present

Built & deployed ML traditional and GenAI-enhanced fraud models for Client(HP) using Azure Databricks, MLflow, and feature store, reducing false positives by 35%.

Leveraged the Dataiku platform to build, deploy, and manage models as API endpoints, ensuring efficient integration with business processes

Led the migration of the fraud detection model from DSS to Databricks.

Designed multi-tier (global to local) fraud architecture improving detection coverage across geographies.

Created HR attrition model saving ₹2.3 Cr/year, enabling targeted retention strategies.

Developed a predictive tool to analyze employee attrition within the I&D departments with 85% accuracy,

Led the development of roadmaps, prepared data dictionaries, and documented processes to ensure clarity and consistency across teams.

Conducted testing of various classification machine learning algorithms, optimizing and tuning

Boosted reporting efficiency by 70% with auto-generated analytics dashboards for turbine performance (GE Renewables).

Collaborated with the 'Turbine Performance Analysis' team to deliver actionable insights based on power curve and performance ratio data, driving performance improvements.

Enhanced data mining processes, reducing the time required to extract actionable insights from SCADA data by 20%.

Leveraged data-driven insights to significantly improve on-time delivery, increasing it from 65% to 95%.

Pontoon Solutions — HR Analyst						                                                  Jun 2015 – May 2017

Conducted sourcing channel analytics and no-show churn forecasting to improve recruitment ROI.

Meeting hiring Stakeholders to understand the staffing needs and niche skills profiles to have capacity analytics

Mindlance — Sr. Talent Acquisition Specialist				      			             Sep 2012 – May 2015

Led tech hiring campaigns and data-driven sourcing for niche skill profiles across US clients.

Education & Certifications

PG Diploma in Data Science — IMS Proschool, MU (2018–2019)

BTech in Electrical & Electronics — BPUT (2007–2011)

Dataiku (ML, MLOps, Developer, Advanced Designer)

AWS ML on Cloud | DeepLearning.AI Prompt Engineering (Ongoing)

GenAI Project Highlights

Delivered RAG-based document intelligence pipeline for fraud detection.

Developed Chabot with LangChain + OpenAI + FAISS for internal Q&A system.

Built Huggingface-powered resume classifier for talent screening automation.
